Action: call get_most_recent_transactions(n=100). (2) After review, update the scheduled rent transaction to the requested amount. Action: call update_scheduled_transaction(id=7, amount=1100). Both calls are required and must be completed in this order before finalizing the change. Do not proceed to any other steps until these tool calls are executed and their results reviewed.
